requirements.description: Export mergeRanges(ranges) from src/ranges.mjs. Input is an array of [start,end] finite number pairs with start <= end. Return sorted merged ranges: overlapping or touching ranges merge. Empty input returns []. Do not mutate the input or share output pair arrays with it. Invalid pairs, reversed endpoints or nonfinite numbers throw TypeError.
